# Site for sale

> Jeremy Murphy & Associates are delighted to present to the market this exceptional residential site, ideally located within walking distance of Rosscarbery village and the beautiful Warren Beach. This superb circa 0.545-acre site is situated in a private rural setting and benefits from outline planning permission for a detached dwelling. (Reference Number 26/1718 ).

- Typ: site
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Lokalita: Curraheen, Rosscarbery
- Cena: 175 000 €
